Low severity, fail-closed: the check `!fs.readFileSync(`${e.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/${workflowPath}`).equals(workflowBytes)` requires the PR-head checkout's workflow file to byte-equal the native workflow blob at GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA (the refs/pull/N/merge commit). If the base branch also modified this workflow file and the three-way merge result differs from the PR head copy, this preflight refuses even though nothing is tampered — the diagnostic job stays red until the PR rebases. This is safe (fails closed) and is the documented intent, but the limitation is worth an explicit comment or a fallback (e.g., verify against the head-tree blob when the merge-tree blob differs) so a legitimate co-change of this file by both base and PR doesn't produce a confusing permanent preflight failure.
